title: Rate limited
detail: The server returned HTTP 403. The server's message (untrusted, quoted): "API rate limit exceeded for 24.209.59.228. (But here's the good news: Authenticated requests get a higher rate limit. Check out the documentation for more details.)"
what_you_should_do: Wait 5719 seconds, then retry with exponential backoff. Stop after a few attempts and report the error if it persists.
